questions.question: Use identify_clusters in order to know Which product type shows the most distinct clustering pattern in terms of price and revenue?

answer.value: Cosmetics products tend to cluster in the higher revenue range with more consistent price points, while skincare and haircare show more scattered distributions across different price and revenue combinations

key_insights: Cluster 1 contains mostly high-revenue products across all types
Cosmetics appear more concentrated in higher-revenue clusters
Skincare and haircare show more diverse distribution across clusters

reasoning.reasoning: Use identify_clusters with n_clusters equal to 3 to identify natural groupings in the data and analyze which product type shows the most distinct clustering pattern
